researched.description: Enterprise conversational and agentic AI platform sold across banking, insurance, retail, healthcare and higher education
researched.notes: Horizontal enterprise AI agent platform; higher education is one named vertical among many. HQ not stated anywhere on the site (about and contact pages give no address).

researched.description: Treasury, payments and liquidity management SaaS for corporate CFOs and treasurers
researched.notes: Horizontal corporate treasury platform; named customers are private enterprises (Spotify, HelloFresh, Baxter). Site, contact and privacy pages give no HQ address and no founding year, so both omitted.

researched.description: Financial planning, cost accounting and decision-support analytics for health systems, universities and banks
researched.notes: Primary market is health systems, with higher education and financial institutions as secondary verticals - a multi-industry product rather than a government-specific one, so flagged for owner review. Founding year not stated on site.

researched.description: Pet licensing, registration and lost-pet reunification platform for municipal animal services departments
researched.notes: Municipal-facing site is at partnerships.docupet.com; docupet.com is the pet-owner front end. Founded in Kingston, Ontario in 2012, added a New York office in 2018.

researched.description: Animal shelter and animal control management software tracking intakes, outcomes, licensing and donations for municipal shelters
researched.notes: Operated by Pet Loyalty Inc (petloyalty.co), which also owns Adopets; HQ address taken from the ShelterBuddy privacy notice. Founding year not published.

researched.description: Plan-It capital improvement planning and budgeting software for cities, counties, utilities, school districts and park districts
researched.notes: Product is branded Plan-It; HQ read from the site's structured-data postal address. Site claims 25+ years in CIP but gives no founding year.

researched.description: Strategic planning and performance management software for local governments, public agencies and other publicly funded organizations
researched.notes: Founding year not stated on the about page.

researched.description: Online, IVR and in-person payment processing for government agencies collecting property taxes, utility bills and court fees
researched.notes: Legal entity is Convenient Payments dba IntelliPay. Also sells to medical, nonprofit and property management, but the government page is the deepest vertical and claims two decades serving state governments. Founding year omitted: site copyright reads 2011 but the government page claims 20+ years, so the two conflict.

researched.description: Tax, property and revenue administration software for state and local government revenue agencies
researched.notes: Sells both the Government Premier platform and implementation consulting; the product line is the core offering. Site says 'nearly three decades' but names no founding year.

researched.description: enQuesta customer information and billing system for municipal electric, gas, water and wastewater utilities
researched.notes: Site claims 50 years of utility expertise but states no founding year.

researched.description: Human capital management platform covering HR, payroll, workforce management and talent for enterprises across all industries
researched.notes: Horizontal HCM (formerly Ceridian); public sector is one of six named industries alongside retail, manufacturing, financial services and sports. No HQ or founding year published on the site's company or contact pages.

researched.description: School district financial management, school nutrition and student data software for K-12 districts
researched.notes: A division of Harris Computer (Constellation Software); the locations page lists the Harris Computer Systems HQ in Ottawa with US offices in Easley SC, Mobile AL, Parsons KS, Pittsburgh PA and elsewhere. Product lines include AptaFund, NextGen, WinCap, eTrition, MealTime and EZSchoolPay. No founding year given.

researched.description: Digital menus, signage, e-ink food labels and mobile ordering for K-12 school nutrition and campus dining programs
researched.notes: Also sells to corporate dining and healthcare foodservice, but K-12 and higher education are the core markets. HQ address taken from the privacy policy (1550 Wewatta St, Denver).

researched.description: Online oversize/overweight, right-of-way and towing permit system for cities, villages, counties and road commissions
researched.notes: Site is a JavaScript app that returns almost no text to a plain fetch; content read via a rendered browser session. Free to the local agency, with carriers paying for permits. No HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Legal case management, document and AI drafting platform for law firms, in-house counsel and government legal offices
researched.notes: Primary buyer is private law firms; state and federal government legal departments (prosecutors, public defenders, attorneys general) are a named but secondary segment, so flagged for owner review. HQ from the privacy policy. Founding year not stated on the site.

researched.description: Community Health Record and care coordination software linking aging networks, FQHCs and state and county health and social services agencies
researched.notes: Formerly Care Coordination Systems, rebranded to CCS Health in 2023. No HQ address published on the site or its contact pages.

researched.description: Case management software for community supervision, pretrial services and specialty courts used by probation departments
researched.notes: Site claims 30 years and 378 departments but states no founding year.

researched.description: Lone-worker safety app, wearable panic button and alert monitoring service for organizations with mobile and field staff
researched.notes: Named industries mix public (social services, probation and parole, utilities) with private (mining, home builders, property management), so it reads as a cross-industry worker-safety product rather than a govtech one. No founding year published.

researched.description: Electronic monitoring devices and community supervision software for parole, probation and pretrial agencies
researched.notes: An Aventiv Technologies company (parent of Securus Technologies and JPay); HQ ZIP 75007 taken from the site's structured data. Offering is device plus platform, not software alone. No founding year published.

researched.description: AI decision-support and process optimization software for industrial operators, including a smart water offering for water and wastewater systems
researched.notes: Could not load calejo.ai from this environment - the origin refused every direct request and a proxy attempt hit a Cloudflare challenge, so all detail comes from indexed search snippets of the site. The registered entity appears to be Calejo Hybrid Intelligence AB (Sweden), whose flagship is Calejo Optimize for smart industries with Calejo Smart Water as a water vertical; I could not confirm that the exhibitor name 'Calejo Water Intelligence' is that same entity, and could not confirm HQ city or founding year. Worth a second look.

researched.description: Field work order and asset management software for local governments and utilities running smart meter and infrastructure projects
researched.notes: Heavy focus on AMI/smart meter deployment programs for gas, water and power utilities. No founding year published.

researched.description: Cloud environmental data management, EHS compliance and ESG reporting software for regulated enterprises and water utilities
researched.notes: Real product company, but the buyer set is any environmentally regulated enterprise - chemical manufacturers and industrials alongside water utilities - so it is not government-specific. Site says 'nearly 30 years' without a founding year.

researched.description: Mobile field service and workforce management software for municipal water, gas, electric, fiber and sanitation utilities
researched.notes: Name collision resolved: this is not ServiceLink the mortgage/title services firm (svclnk.com). The given URL service-link.us 301-redirects to servicelinksoftware.com, which is the canonical site. Site claims 30 years of industry experience but no founding year.

researched.description: Physics-informed AI forecasting of water supply, quality and drought risk for water utilities and infrastructure operators
researched.notes: Also markets to corporate water users and investors on supply-chain and disclosure risk, which pulls it partly outside the public-sector buyer; utilities are the first named audience. Site is a JS app read via a rendered browser session; no about page, HQ or founding year published.

researched.description: Records digitization, preservation and archival supply services for county clerks, courts and assessors
researched.notes: Judgment call: they do ship a software platform (Kleio, AI document intelligence), but the solutions pages present preservation, digitization and archival products - binders, boxes, plat cabinets, shelving - as the core, staffed by preservationists and archivists. Reads as a services firm with a software layer, not a product company. No founding year published.

researched.description: Online workforce skills training and career services platform for state workforce agencies and local workforce development boards
researched.notes: Legal entity is NY Wired for Education dba Metrix Learning, founded by Brian Lee; the about page dates the launch to 2008. Company is in upstate New York (518 area code) but no city is published, so HQ omitted.

researched.description: FedHire talent acquisition and hiring management system for government agencies
researched.notes: Rebranded from Monster Government Solutions in 2025; monstergov.com now 301-redirects here. Current site is positioned almost entirely at federal agencies, which is a shift from the state workforce systems the MonsterGov name was known for - worth a look if the tracker is state-and-local only. Claims 24+ years but names no founding year, and no HQ address is published.

researched.description: AI identity verification, fraud detection and risk decisioning platform sold across banking, crypto, gaming, telecom and public sector
researched.notes: Horizontal identity platform; public sector is one of roughly ten named industries and the flagship references are large banks and card issuers. No HQ or founding year published on the site.

researched.description: Social media management, community engagement surveys and public-records archiving for government communications teams
researched.notes: Two things to flag. First, this is not the original MindMixer civic-engagement startup (that became mySidewalk); the name is now used by Social Assurance, which rebranded its 'Social Assurance for Government' line as MindMixer. Second, the parent also serves banking, financial services and education, so only the MindMixer line is government-specific. No founding year published.

researched.description: RTA Fleet360 fleet maintenance and asset management system for government fleets, school districts and transit agencies
researched.notes: HQ from the site's structured-data address; homepage states 'Est. 1979'.

researched.description: Enterprise secure browser and workspace control plane sold across healthcare, financial services, BPO, manufacturing, retail, government and education
researched.notes: Horizontal enterprise security product; government and education are two of eight named industries. No founding year published.

researched.description: Low-code process orchestration, RPA and AI automation platform for enterprises across financial services, insurance, life sciences and government
researched.notes: Horizontal low-code platform. Site claims 25+ years but gives no founding year, and no HQ address is exposed on the company or offices pages.

researched.description: Cloud contact center and AI customer experience platform sold across financial services, retail, healthcare, utilities and government
researched.notes: Horizontal CCaaS vendor; 'Government & Education' is one of nine named industries and the marquee logos are consumer brands. Founding year not confirmed from the company's own pages, so omitted.

researched.description: Network, cloud, endpoint and workspace cybersecurity products for enterprises and governments worldwide
researched.notes: General-purpose cybersecurity vendor; federal and state/local government is one of eight named industries. About page states 'a leader in cyber security since 1993' and lists Tel Aviv as international corporate HQ.

researched.description: Automated software testing and quality engineering platform for enterprise and public sector IT organizations
researched.notes: Horizontal test-automation tooling with a public sector landing page. Homepage blocked WebFetch with a header-overflow error; read via curl. No founding year published.

researched.description: Identity and access management, rostering and access governance for K-12 school districts and universities
researched.notes: Acquired by Jamf and now branded 'Identity Automation, a Jamf Company'; the contact page now lists Jamf's Minneapolis global HQ plus an Austin office, so the historic Houston HQ no longer applies. Healthcare is a third named vertical alongside K-12 and higher ed. No founding year published.

researched.description: E-Rate application, funding and compliance management software for schools, libraries and the vendors that serve them
researched.notes: Sells to both sides of the E-Rate program - school and library applicants, and the service providers, VARs and OEMs bidding on that funding. No HQ or founding year published; the phone number is a California 626 area code but that is not confirmation.

researched.description: AI math tutoring platform with a teacher dashboard for K-12 schools and districts
researched.notes: Legal entity is Learnie, Inc. dba Thinkverse. No founding year published. Category is the closest fit in the map; there is no K-12 instruction/curriculum category.

researched.description: AI service desk and service operations platform unifying IT, facilities, HR and transportation requests for K-12 districts
researched.notes: Candidate was listed as K12 Insight; k12insight.com now 308-redirects to onflo.com and the footer reads 'Onflo (formerly K12 Insight)', so the card should carry the new name. No founding year published.

researched.description: Web research, annotation and writing platform licensed by schools and districts for students and teachers
researched.notes: Also sold to individual professionals, but the school and district edition is the institutional business. No HQ or founding year published on the site.
